svg.title: Exact golden integers Z[φ]
svg.desc: Top: the numbers a plus b phi for small integers a and b placed on the real line, one row per value of b, with their union below. Bottom: the Galois-conjugate embedding that sends the pair a, b to the point a plus b phi and a plus b phi-bar in the plane, a lattice, with the points in a horizontal band projecting to an aperiodic exact chain on the line.
svg.text: a + bφ on the real line (φ = 1.6180…)
band |x′| ≤ φ/2: its points project to an aperiodic chain
Z[φ] = { a + bφ : a, b ∈ ℤ }, φ² = φ + 1
norm N(a+bφ) = a² + ab − b² ∈ ℤ
every product, sum and norm stays an
exact integer pair — never a rounded float.
Icosian coordinates are exact numbers a + bφ (integers a, b); chirality and polarity are exact signs of these coordinates.
Rows b = −3…3 are integers shifted by bφ; below, each a + bφ is paired with its conjugate a + bφ̄ (φ̄ = 1 − φ).
